capabilities: Translate plugin UI labels into Simplified Chinese via DeepSeek, OpenAI, OpenRouter, DeepL or DeepLX
Apply saved dictionaries offline to recognized settings, menus and controls
Restore English labels without deleting dictionaries
Supplement translations for new labels after plugin updates
Store API keys through Obsidian's native keychain control
disambiguation: Not a note or app-wide translator; it only rewrites recognizable plugin interface labels and never touches note bodies, input values or plugin source files.
extras: Free and open source with no paid unlock; not yet reviewed for the official community directory (manual install from GitHub Releases); tested only on Windows with Obsidian 1.15.0, no mobile support; dictionaries and progress files are stored outside the vault and are not deleted on uninstall; canceling a translation job may not stop server execution or billing.
problem: Obsidian and its community plugins ship English-only interfaces, and there is no built-in way to localize plugin settings, menus and controls into Chinese.
